personal.title: Personal details
personal.mobile-help: Optional, for queries from the connected applications

email.title: Email addresses
email.login-pending-text: We sent a confirmation link to the new address. Until you open it, you keep signing in with the current address.
email.recovery-help: Confirmed · only for recovering your account, not for signing in
email.recovery-none: No recovery email set. It lets you recover your account if you lose access to your sign-in email.
email.recovery-pending-text: We sent a confirmation link to this address. It can recover your account only after you confirm it.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Your account is deactivated, all sessions end and you lose access to all connected applications. This cannot be undone.

password.title: Password
password.text: Choose a password you use nowhere else. Changing it signs out all other sessions.

totp.title: Two-factor sign-in
totp.text-on: After your password, sign-in asks for a code from your authenticator app. You received the backup codes during setup.
totp.text-off: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.text: "Active" means signed in. "Signed out" means the device is remembered and can sign in again without password and two-factor sign-in. Remove entries you don't recognize.
sessions.delete-current: This includes the session you are using right now. You will have to sign in again.

history.title: Sign-in history
history.text: If a sign-in looks unfamiliar, change your password.

apps.title: Connected applications
apps.none: You are not connected to any application.
apps.remove-hint: If you remove an application, you lose all roles and tenants there. An admin has to invite you again.

documents.tos-privacy: Terms of use and privacy policy

password.title: Change password
password.info-heading: All other sessions will be signed out
password.info: You stay signed in on this device. Everywhere else you have to sign in again with the new password.
password.success: Your new password is valid now.

email.text-login: We send a confirmation link to the new address. Until you open it, you keep signing in with the current address.
email.text-recovery: We send a confirmation link to the address. It can recover your account only after you confirm it. It is not used for signing in.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.heading: This cannot be undone
delete.text: Your account is deactivated, all sessions end and you lose access to all connected applications.
delete.confirm: Enter your sign-in email to confirm

enroll.title: Set up two-factor sign-in
enroll.step-scan: 1. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, for example Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator.
enroll.step-code: 2. Enter the six-digit code the app shows.
enroll.failure: The code does not match. Check the time on your phone and try the next code.
enroll.codes-text: Keep the backup codes safe. Each code works once if you have no access to your authenticator app. They are shown only now.

unroll.title: Turn off two-factor sign-in
unroll.text: Without a second factor, your password is enough to sign in. Confirm with a code from your authenticator app or a backup code.
unroll.code: Code from the app or backup code
unroll.failure: The code does not match. Try the next code from the app or a backup code.

sign-out-others.title: Sign out all other sessions?
sign-out-others.text: You stay signed in on this device. On the other devices you have to sign in again, remembered ones included.

remove-app.title: Remove access to {{APP}}?
remove-app.heading: Roles and tenants will be lost
remove-app.text: You lose all roles and tenants in this application. An admin has to invite you again.
remove-app.confirm: Enter your sign-in email to confirm
